title: Leave
subtitle: 「離開／出發／走開／退出」，這是一個非常多義的動詞。這個單元集中處理『離開某地／退出某情境』sense，而不是 leave something behind、leave a job
description: 「離開／出發／走開／退出」，這是一個非常多義的動詞。這個單元集中處理『離開某地／退出某情境』sense，而不是 leave something behind、leave a job 等其他義項。

words.example: The train departs from Platform 4 at 8:30.
words.exampleZh: 火車於八時三十分從四號月台開出。

exercises.original: The train leaves from Platform 4 at 8:30.
exercises.zh: 火車於八時三十分從四號月台開出。
exercises.upgrade: The train departs from Platform 4 at 8:30.

options.explanation: scheduled transport leaving a station is a classic depart context。
abandon implies desertion。
escape implies getting free from danger/control。
quit applies to jobs/activities。
resign applies to formal positions。
go focuses movement but misses the scheduled departure nuance.

exercises.original: Our flight leaves at noon.
exercises.zh: 我們的航班中午起飛離開。
exercises.upgrade: Our flight departs at noon.

options.explanation: flight timetable language naturally uses departs。
quit/resign do not apply to flights。
escape/abandon are semantically wrong。
goes away is too conversational for a schedule.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

options.explanation: formal travel departure from a hotel suits depart。
abandon/escape/quit/resign are wrong senses。

falseSynonyms.zh: 拋棄不等於普通 leave abandon 帶放棄、遺棄、不再返回的強烈意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Abandon is much stronger than ordinary leave.

falseSynonyms.zh: 逃走不等於 leave escape 表示逃離危險、拘禁或不想要的情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Escape implies getting free from danger or control.

falseSynonyms.zh: quit 只在停止工作／活動 sense 接近 leave quit a job 可以等於 leave a job，但不能泛指離開任何地方。
辭職不等於 leave resign 只表示正式辭去職位。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Resign is a formal employment/office term.

falseSynonyms.zh: exit 只在離開空間／系統 sense 接近 leave exit 偏跨出邊界，不等於所有 leave 義項。
depart 只在出發／離開地點 sense 接近 leave depart 較正式，且不涵蓋 leave behind 等義項。
去不等於 leave go 只表示移動；leave 強調離開起點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Go focuses movement; leave focuses departure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 leave 是原形；left 是過去式／過去分詞，也可作『左邊的』形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Left has multiple grammatical roles.
